title: Screen rubric datasets and pick one (R0-R3) -> STOP: owner picks
description:
## Purpose

Screen 4 candidate datasets whose gold labels were made under a published guideline, and pick one (owner decision) for the simulated-stakeholder experiment. Tasks R0-R3, ending at **STOP: owner picks the dataset**.

## Pass rule

(a) Jev-S (one-line rubric) clearly below the reported human ceiling; (b) a real published guideline whose nuance one line plausibly does not carry; (c) a free local supervised baseline beats Jev-S by a clear margin on held-out items. Condition F (excerpted full guideline, <= ~25k tokens) is an informative ceiling, not a gate.

## Cost

R0-R2 $0; R3 ~1,200 Jev requests, cap ~$1.

## Definition of done

Screening table per candidate (license, guideline, human ceiling, supervised baseline, Jev-S, Jev-F, Jev-S+8-shot on top 2, macro-F1 with paired bootstrap CIs, pass/fail on (a)-(c)) attached to R3; owner decision recorded.
